therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: monoclonal antibody binding to soluble amyloid beta peptides
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: amyloid plaque clearance and prevention of amyloid aggregation
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: safety monitoring - number of participants with drug-related adverse events or serious adverse events

results.effect_size: SAE: 299/734 solanezumab vs 308/723 placebo; Other AE: 514/734 solanezumab vs 485/723 placebo
results.target_engagement_evidence: plasma amyloid beta levels measured but no significant changes observed
biomarker_changes: plasma Aβ 1-40 levels similar between groups
plasma Aβ 1-42 levels similar between groups
hippocampal volume loss similar between groups
amyloid imaging showed minimal change (-0.01 SUVr solanezumab vs 0.00 placebo)
subgroup_findings: mild Alzheimer's disease showed numerically better outcomes on some measures
moderate Alzheimer's disease showed mixed results across endpoints
safety_signals: similar rates of serious adverse events between groups
cardiac events including atrial fibrillation and myocardial infarction observed in both groups

context.duration: up to 8 years with 104-week primary endpoint
context.investigator_commentary: Solanezumab did not meet the primary endpoint in study H8A-MC-LZAX.
